definitions.explanation: A sharp blade used for shaving hair from the face or body.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{剃刀|かみそり}で{髭|ひげ}を{剃|そ}る。
examples.english: I shave my beard with a razor every morning.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{捨|す}ての{剃刀|かみそり}を{買|か}った。
{剃刀|かみそり}の{刃|は}を{交換|こうかん}した。

notes:
{剃刀|かみそり} is often written in hiragana (かみそり) in everyday use. The kanji {剃|そ}る means 'to shave.'

Types of razors:
- {使|つか}い{捨|す}て{剃刀|かみそり} (disposable razor)
- {電気|でんき}{剃刀|かみそり} (electric razor/shaver)
- T{字|じ}{剃刀|かみそり} (safety razor)

Common collocations:
- {剃刀|かみそり}で{剃|そ}る (to shave with a razor)
- {剃刀|かみそり}の{刃|は} (razor blade)
- {剃刀|かみそり}{負|ま}け (razor burn)

Also commonly written as カミソリ in katakana.
